case.title: The weekend dropdown offers two shifts the business rules forbid

steps.text: Open the Saturday 2026-10-03 and open the shift dropdown.
screenshots: C:\Users\patel\Documents\ServiceNow Work Project Docs\Personal AI Assisted\ShiftPay Clean Vibe coding\testing\automation\evidence\TC-SP-005\01-saturday-dropdown-six-options.png

steps.text: Read the catalogue rows that cause it.

records.label: What the Saturday dropdown offers, by group heading

rows.label: On Call Allowance, if you have worked as a Stand-by on the Holiday
On call Allowance + Compensatory off, if you have worked on Holiday, in the regular hours not in the UK or US Shift
On call Allowance + Compensatory off+ UK Shift, if you have worked on the holiday in the UK shift
On call Allowance + Compensatory off+ US Shift, if you have worked on the holiday in the US shift

rows.name: OC
rows.description: On Call Allowance, if you have worked as a Stand-by on the Holiday

rows.name: OC + CO
rows.description: On call Allowance + Compensatory off, if you have worked on Holiday, in the regular hours not in the UK or US Shift

rows.name: OC + UK + CO
rows.description: On call Allowance + Compensatory off+ UK Shift, if you have worked on the holiday in the UK shift

rows.name: OC + US + CO

observations: Cause: the catalogue rows "L" and "Not Eligible" carry allow_weekend_holiday = true. Availability is data-driven, so the widget is faithfully rendering what the data says — the data is what disagrees with the specification.
FIX is a data change, not a code change: untick allow_weekend_holiday on those rows. No widget is touched, and nothing needs redeploying.
SEVERITY today is cosmetic only because both offending rows are rated at 0. The same mistake on a paid row would put money on a day nobody worked, which is a pay bug rather than a tidiness one.

ADJACENT: the consumes_co row carries day_category = holiday while allow_weekend_holiday = false, so the legend and the dropdown file CO under "Holiday work (weekend or declared holiday)" — a class of day on which it can never be logged. Cosmetic, but it sends a user looking in the wrong place. Recorded here rather than raised as its own case.
expected: README section "Business Rules — Shift Availability" states the weekend/holiday set is exactly OC, OC+CO, OC+UK+CO and OC+US+CO.
A Saturday therefore offers four shift types, and no others.
actual: The Saturday dropdown offers 6 shift types: L, Not Eligible, OC, OC + CO, OC + UK + CO, OC + US + CO.
2 of them are not in the documented weekend set: L, Not Eligible.
case.verdictReason: The weekend dropdown offers 6 shift types where the documented rules allow 4. L and Not Eligible should not be selectable on a Saturday.
